method.same_path_identity: Same repository-relative path and identical Git blob SHA.
method.shared_blob_identity: Identical Git blob SHA anywhere in both repositories, path-independent; unique SHA counted once per pair.
method.byte_share_denominator: Smaller repository total blob bytes at the exact indexed head.
method.claim_ceiling: Byte identity only. Does not establish lineage, desired dependency direction, semantic equivalence, or consolidation value.

summary.caveat: This scan binds only the exact indexed default-branch heads. It does not cover open PR/branch-only bytes, historical commits, generated artifacts absent from Git, or semantic similarity without byte identity.
